edits.value_json: Current use; historical examples include singular and plural uses, but exact priority and dating remain unresolved

你 is a current second-person pronoun meaning “you.” A character dictionary also records bare 你 in plural examples from historical works, while ordinary modern plural usage is documented in 你们. The cited examples do not establish the present-day frequency or productivity of bare-你 plural use, the exact earliest surviving occurrence, or the date of quoted passages’ wording.

No inspected source establishes whether 尔 originally depicted an object or provides an independently recoverable pronunciation for any such object-name. This limits an object-based interpretation of 尔’s own history; it does not by itself resolve 尔’s proposed phonetic role in 你.
